email.finishRegistrationSubject: Finalize the creation of your account!
email.finishRegistration: To complete your account registration, use the code below to verify your email address.
email.codeDuration: Please note that this code will only be valid for 1 hour.
email.ifAnyProblem: If you have any problems, please contact us
email.subject: subject
email.requestYourPassword: You recently requested to reset your password for your account.
email.enterCode: Enter the code below to reset it.
email.reportThresholdReachedMessage: {{count}} unresolved reports have been recorded on {{targetType}} ({{targetId}}). Please review this case.
email.preventiveSuspensionSubject: Your account has been temporarily suspended
email.preventiveSuspensionMessage: Following multiple reports, your account has been suspended for {{days}} days. Our moderation team is reviewing your case.
email.reportResolvedMessage: Thank you for your report. Our moderation team has reviewed it and taken the appropriate action.
email.welcomeMessage: Hi {{fullName}}, your account is now verified. You're all set to search for a ride or offer one.
email.accountReactivatedMessage: Good news! Your account suspension has ended and you can now use the app normally again.
email.newDeviceLoginMessage: A login to your Portfolio account was detected from a new device: {{deviceName}}. If this wasn't you, change your password immediately and review your active sessions in the app settings.
email.passwordResetDelayedSubject: Password change requested on your account
email.passwordResetDelayedMessage: Someone asked to change the password of your Portfolio account using your phone number, while the account has not been used for a long time. For your security, the password cannot be changed before {{date}}. If this is you, there is nothing to do: come back after that date. Otherwise, open the app and tap "It wasn't me" in the notification, or sign in to your account right now: either cancels the request.
email.passwordResetContestedSubject: Password: request contested by the account owner
email.passwordResetContestedMessage: The owner of the account {{- name}} (id {{- userId}}) says the password change held back on their account, after a long period without sign-in, was not theirs. The request has been cancelled. Their phone number may have been reassigned, or someone is trying to take the account over: check the account before any intervention.
email.invitationSubject: You've been invited to join the Portfolio back office
email.invitationMessage: {{inviterName}} has invited you to create an admin account on the back office.
email.invitationMessageWithRole: {{inviterName}} has invited you to create an admin account on the back office, as {{role}}.

ownerAlert.notYou: If you did not expect this action, sign in to the back-office and check it right away.

highestRoleLogin.subject: Back-office sign-in: {{actor}}
highestRoleLogin.message: {{actor}} just signed in to the back-office with the {{roles}} post.

usersDestroyed.subject: Accounts erased for good
usersDestroyed.message: {{actor}} erased {{count}} account(s) for good from the bin.

moneyActions.ridePassengersRefund: Refund of the passengers of a ride

email.invitationRolesFailedSubject: Invited account created without a role
email.invitationRolesFailedMessage: {{targetEmail}} signed up from an invitation, but the invited roles could not be given. The account exists without any role: please add them from the user page.
email.reportSubmittedMessage: Thank you for your report. Our moderation team will review it shortly.
email.newsletterUnsubscribeConfirmationMessage: You have successfully unsubscribed from the Portfolio newsletter. You will no longer receive these emails.
email.receiptResentMessage: Please find your payment receipt attached.
email.accountBannedTemporary: Your account has been banned until {{until}} for the following reason: {{reason}}.
email.accountBannedPermanent: Your account has been permanently banned for the following reason: {{reason}}.
email.ticketReplySubject: A reply to your request — Portfolio
email.ticketReplyIntro: The support team has answered the request you sent us from our website.
email.ticketReplyCannotReplyTitle: This email cannot receive a reply
email.ticketReplyCannotReplyBody: Your request was sent from our website without an account, so we have no thread to continue the conversation in. If you reply to this email, nobody will receive it.
email.ticketReplyWriteAgain: Write to us again from the contact form
email.ticketAcknowledgementIntro: Thank you for writing to us. Your message has reached the support team, who will answer you by email as soon as possible.
email.ticketAcknowledgementNextSteps: Keep this number: quote it if you write to us or call us again about the same request. There is no need to reply to this email.
email.newsletterConfirmationSubject: Confirm your subscription to the Portfolio newsletter
email.newsletterConfirmationMessage: Someone — hopefully you — asked to receive the Portfolio newsletter at this address. Confirm with the button below to start receiving our news. If you did not ask for it, simply ignore this email: you will receive nothing.
email.confirmNewEmail: You asked to use this address to sign in to Portfolio. Enter the code below in the app to confirm it.
email.confirmNewEmailIgnore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your account stays unchanged.
email.accountProtected: To protect your account, our support team has blocked it until {{until}}, for example after your phone was stolen. This is not a sanction. Have your SIM card blocked by your operator, then contact support if you need access sooner.
email.smsOutOfCreditSubject: SMS credit exhausted — no text is delivered anymore
email.smsOutOfCreditMessage: The SMS provider refused a text because the account has no credit left. Until it is topped up, no SMS goes out: sign-up codes, password resets, SOS alerts and notification fallbacks. Top up the MMSDuck account as soon as possible.
email.smsDailyCeilingSubject: SMS daily ceiling reached — sign-up codes are refused
email.smsDailyCeilingMessage: The platform reached its daily ceiling of {{limit}} verification texts. Until the counter starts over, new sign-ups and code requests by SMS are refused. If this is a normal busy day, raise the ceiling; if not, this may be an abuse of the sign-up form: check the server logs.
email.contactChangedEmailSubject: The sign-in email of your Portfolio account was changed
email.contactChangedEmailMessage: The sign-in email address of your Portfolio account was just changed. If this was you, there is nothing more to do. If it was not, contact support right away and change your password: all your other devices have been signed out.

sms.contactChanged: Portfolio: the phone number of your account was changed. If this wasn't you, contact support right away.
sms.rideCancelled: Ride cancelled: {{- departure}} - {{- destination}} on {{- date}}. You've been refunded.
sms.newDeviceLogin: New login to your Portfolio account from: {{- deviceName}}. If this wasn't you, change your password.

sms.bookingCanceledByDriver: Portfolio: booking cancelled by the driver, ride {{- departure}} - {{- destination}} on {{- date}}. You have been fully refunded.
sms.requestPaymentFailed: Portfolio: payment failed, ride {{- departure}} - {{- destination}} on {{- date}}. No seat booked.
sms.sosAlert: Portfolio: {{- name}} raised an SOS alert during their ride {{- departure}} - {{- destination}} ({{- vehicle}} {{- plate}}). Support has been alerted.
sms.ticketAcknowledgement: Portfolio: we received your request #{{reference}}. Support will answer you by SMS or phone call. Keep this number.
